narrative.northStar: The Standard Engineer CV, Done Precisely
narrative.overview:
This is the category standard for a personal engineer CV: a dark page, one left-aligned column, name and role first, contact actions right below, then experience, skills, and education. No concept, no costume. The quality is in the type, the spacing, and what is left out.

The page is monochrome. One near-black ground, three greys of ink, one hairline colour. There is no hue anywhere. Hierarchy comes from ink level and weight, not from colour or containers. Every dated item sits on the same grid: a 176px date column on the left and the content on the right, from 768px up.

Density is calm and readable: 17px body text on a 28px line, generous section gaps (128px on desktop), and technologies written as plain text. The one entrance motion is the header settling in on load.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome dark: no hue, no gradients, no glow.
Geist for all text; Geist Mono only for dates.
One date-column grid shared by experience, education, certificates, and skills.
Flat: no shadows and no cards. One hairline grid box, the hero contact block, is the only bordered structure.
Technologies as middot-separated text, never pills or badges.

rules.name: The No Hue Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a neutral grey. Do not add an accent colour, a tinted link, or a coloured status mark. Emphasis is ink level (ink, ink-2, ink-3) and weight.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: Text uses only ink (#ededef) for primary content, ink-2 (#a0a0a8) for secondary content, and ink-3 (#6e6e76) for separators and marks. Do not use ink-3 for readable text.

rules.name: The Mono Is For Dates Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono is used only for dates and periods in the label column. Do not use it for labels, tags, headings, or decoration. Non-date labels in the column (skill categories) switch back to Geist at the small size.

rules.name: The Weight Not Size Rule
rules.body: Within a section, separate levels with weight (400, 500, 600) and ink level, not with extra sizes. Do not add sizes outside the scale.

rules.name: The One Date Column Rule
rules.body: Experience, education, certificates, and skills all use the same Row grid (176px label, 32px gap). Do not make a second grid or move dates to the right.

rules.name: The Hairline Grid Rule
rules.body: Boxes are hairline grids, never cards: one 1px Grid Line border, 6px outer corners, no fill, no shadow, and cells that share 1px seams (a `gap-px` grid on a Grid Line background, each cell on the ground). Today only the hero contact block is boxed; other sections group with whitespace and the date column.

dos: **Do** keep every colour in the seven-token grey scale (#0e0e10, #19191c, #ededef, #a0a0a8, #6e6e76, #26262a, #34343a).
**Do** put every dated item in the Row grid with a 176px label column from 768px up.
**Do** write technologies as plain text separated by middots.
**Do** use Geist Mono only for dates.
**Do** use the global focus ring (2px solid #ededef, 3px offset) for every interactive element.
**Do** keep content to real facts from `src/data/`.
donts: **Don't** add an accent hue, gradient, or glow.
**Don't** show technologies or skills as pills, badges, or chips.
**Don't** use cards, tinted panels, or box-shadow. Structure that needs a box uses the hairline grid.
**Don't** add more than the two header buttons; other actions are text links.
**Don't** add entrance animation beyond the header settle.
